title: 压小以后还会解题吗？
summary: OnQ先校准量化模型，再让它自己生成回答，向原始模型学习怎样续写，并根据各候选的概率差异调整训练。下面逐步解释机制、结果及限制。

panels.title: 想把会解题的模型装进小内存
panels.visual: At a small worktable, kumo tries to slide a thick bundle of plain cards into an already full shallow storage drawer and pauses when it will not close. Papi crouches beside the drawer, stopping the push with one open paw and inspecting the available space. Nezu steadies the drawer from the other side and watches the fit critically. The props are an illustrative storage-capacity problem, with no cards removed, no magically shrunken model, and no claimed outcome.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 这个模型解题很厉害，可它太大了，我的机器装不下。

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 那就得想办法让它少占内存，同时尽量别把解题能力弄丢。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 变小不难，难的是变小以后还会不会解题。

panels.narration: 情境示意：小云想在内存不大的机器上运行一个会一步步解题的语言模型。
panels.shows: At a small worktable, kumo tries to slide a thick bundle of plain cards into an already full shallow storage drawer and pauses when it will not close. Papi crouches beside the drawer, stopping the push with one open paw and inspecting the available space. Nezu steadies the drawer from the other side and watches the fit critically. The props are an illustrative storage-capacity problem, with no cards removed, no magically shrunken model, and no claimed outcome.

panels.title: 量化：权重一个不少，只是记得更粗
panels.visual: Below the board, papi holds both paws at the same width to stress an unchanged amount, kumo leans forward with paws close together as if asking about finer increments, and nezu examines the gesture with one paw raised. Keep their actions in the lower strip without any bead rows or precision diagrams.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 量化不是删掉一部分权重。权重个数没变，只是参与量化的数用更少的刻度表示。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 就像原来能精确到很多位小数，现在只能在几个刻度里挑一个？

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 刻度越少越省地方，也越容易失真。

panels.narration: 模型里有大量叫“权重”的数字。量化不靠删掉这些数字来省内存，而是把参与量化的权重记得更粗。

right.label: 量化后的模型
items: 参与量化的权重用2或3位：4或8个刻度

panels.title: 压得太狠，长题写不完
panels.visual: Kumo feeds a single blank paper strip across a desk until it meets a plain physical end-stop; its paw remains poised to continue. Papi gently holds the feeder still at that boundary while nezu points out that the action has stopped before kumo is ready. Show one finite illustrative strip and a visible stopping boundary, with no comparison scroll, no outcome marks and no endless paper.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 论文里的结果显示：在需要长推理的题上，有的压缩模型会一直写到长度上限，还没收尾。

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 这种长度上限原本足够完整模型完成回答，却常常不够这些压缩模型用。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 所以麻烦不只是答错，还有停不下来。

panels.narration: 论文观察到：即使压缩后再做补救训练，低位模型遇到需要长推理的题目时仍常常吃力。
panels.shows: Kumo feeds a single blank paper strip across a desk until it meets a plain physical end-stop; its paw remains poised to continue. Papi gently holds the feeder still at that boundary while nezu points out that the action has stopped before kumo is ready. Show one finite illustrative strip and a visible stopping boundary, with no comparison scroll, no outcome marks and no endless paper.

panels.title: 先写下要弄清的三件事
panels.visual: Kumo alone stands at the lower-left corner of the board, holding a capped marker away from its surface and turning toward the reader with an eager questioning gesture. No writing or checkmarks are made.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 先把要弄清的事写下来，最后再一条条回答。

board.title: 我们的问题
items: 压缩后的模型，推理时哪里出了问题？
新方法怎么训练，学生跟谁学？
效果到底有多大，还差在哪里？

panels.title: 写答案就是不断接下一个片段
panels.visual: At the lower edge of the board, papi slides one plain tile toward kumo on a narrow desk, demonstrating one small next step. Kumo reaches to receive that one tile. Use only this small handoff, not a long path or another sequence diagram.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 语言模型写答案时，一次只接一个小片段。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 那一段长推理，岂不是要接成千上万次？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 对。论文里很多回答都有几千甚至上万个片段。

board.title: 模型怎样写出一段回答
steps: 读题目和目前已经写出的内容
挑出下一个文字片段，接到末尾
回到第一步，直到写完或碰到长度上限
board.note: 一个文字片段可以是一个词、半个词或一个标点，论文里叫token。

panels.title: 前缀：已经写出的那一段
panels.visual: On a tabletop, an unprinted broad starting card lies beside a short, already assembled row of blank tiles. Papi sweeps one paw over the starting card and the existing row together. Kumo holds one new tile just beyond the row's end, pausing before placing it; nezu points to the already assembled row rather than the new tile. All three look at this shared context.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 每接一个片段，都要依据题目和已经写出的内容。这一整段就叫前缀。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 每接一次，前缀就长一点。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 那越往后，前缀里模型自己写的东西就越多。

panels.narration: 题目加上到目前为止写出的全部内容，叫“前缀”。下一步怎么接，取决于前缀。
panels.shows: On a tabletop, an unprinted broad starting card lies beside a short, already assembled row of blank tiles. Papi sweeps one paw over the starting card and the existing row together. Kumo holds one new tile just beyond the row's end, pausing before placing it; nezu points to the already assembled row rather than the new tile. All three look at this shared context.

panels.title: 下一步：每个候选都有一个概率
panels.visual: Papi spreads a small fan of equal-size plain candidate cards on a table; kumo pauses with a paw above one card, and nezu holds up an open paw to emphasize that other alternatives remain. Show the moment of considering a next candidate, not a literal random lottery mechanism. No varying card areas, repeated cards, probability numerals or bar heights.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 所以模型不是只想到一个词？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 它心里有一整张表：这个片段可能性多大，那个片段可能性多大，全部加起来是百分之百。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 既然是按概率抽，同一个前缀后面也可能接出不同的片段。

panels.narration: 面对同一个前缀，模型给每个可能的下一片段各打一个概率。这一整组概率叫“概率分布”。模型按这组概率抽出一个片段接上。
panels.shows: Papi spreads a small fan of equal-size plain candidate cards on a table; kumo pauses with a paw above one card, and nezu holds up an open paw to emphasize that other alternatives remain. Show the moment of considering a next candidate, not a literal random lottery mechanism. No varying card areas, repeated cards, probability numerals or bar heights.

panels.title: 老师和学生
panels.visual: Papi crouches at the lower-left of the board, one paw held still while the other makes a small careful adjustment gesture. Kumo at lower-right watches the moving paw and tilts its head toward the still one. Show only papi and kumo, with no teacher/student statues, model replicas or precision diagrams.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 补救训练里有两个角色：没压缩的原模型当老师，压缩后的模型当学生。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 老师也要改吗？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 老师不改，只调整学生。 更细的权重方便训练时微调，再按粗刻度参与计算。省内存说的是量化后的使用目标，不是说训练本身也只占这么点内存。

panels.narration: 训练时仍保留更精细的权重供更新；计算下一步时，才使用量化后的权重。

right.label: 学生：量化后的模型
items: 前向计算用2或3位的权重
训练时保留更细的权重来更新

panels.title: 现有做法：沿着写好的固定回答训练
panels.visual: Papi at the lower-left holds a closed plain booklet fixed on the desk, without turning its pages. Nezu leans in from lower-right and points questioningly at that same booklet. The booklet is only a modest prop for prepared material; no track, forced passenger or extra student.

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 听起来挺合理啊，问题出在哪？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 问题就出在前缀是从哪来的。看下一格。

panels.narration: 训练时把量化带来的变化也考虑进去，叫量化感知训练（QAT）。这里比较的常见做法，用一批预先写好的回答来训练。

board.title: 常见的QAT训练
steps: 准备一批写好的题目和回答
沿着固定回答的每个前缀，老师给出下一片段的概率
调整学生，让它的概率贴近老师
board.note: 整个过程中，前缀都来自固定回答，而不是学生自己写出来的。

panels.title: 同一个位置，两种接法
panels.visual: Papi and kumo sit below the board. Papi's gaze follows one comparison side while kumo turns toward the other, holding two paws slightly apart in a discovering gesture. Their contrasting eyelines direct attention to the code comparison without drawing another fork, signpost or path.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 前半段一模一样。到了接“So”的地方，学生写的是“Wait”。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 从这里开始，两段文字就分开了。

panels.narration: 这是论文用来说明机制的示意图，不是某道题的实测解题记录。

right.label: 学生自己写的
items: … not the case . Wait , the problem says …
意思：……并非如此。等等，题目说……

panels.title: 分叉不一定错，但原来的训练可能没覆盖
panels.visual: On a uniformly lit desk, a simple unprinted sample row and a second row begin with matching tiles but end with different-shaped tiles. Kumo holds the different final tile thoughtfully, not fearfully. Nezu raises a questioning paw; papi holds an open reassuring paw between the two rows without choosing a winner. No dark path, warning signs or correct/incorrect symbols; this is an illustrative divergence only.

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 写成“Wait”就算错了吗？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 不一定。回头再看一眼题目，也可能是合理的做法。 关键是：如果只沿着图中那条固定回答训练，就没有在“... Wait , the problem says”这条新前缀上指导学生。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 也就是说，平时练到的内容，可能覆盖不到它自己真正写出来的内容。

panels.narration: 训练时见到的前缀，和学生真正写答案时遇到的前缀，对不上。
panels.shows: On a uniformly lit desk, a simple unprinted sample row and a second row begin with matching tiles but end with different-shaped tiles. Kumo holds the different final tile thoughtfully, not fearfully. Nezu raises a questioning paw; papi holds an open reassuring paw between the two rows without choosing a winner. No dark path, warning signs or correct/incorrect symbols; this is an illustrative divergence only.

panels.title: 回答越长，偏得越远
panels.visual: Papi holds one short prepared strip of blank tiles beside a longer loose strip whose later tile sequence differs. Nezu traces only the later differing section with a fingertip, asking for evidence. Keep the strips on a desk with no horizon, calibrated gap, distance ruler or numerical trend; they illustrate different continuations rather than measured divergence.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 学生接出不同的片段，后面面对的内容也随之改变。论文发现，回答越长，训练内容与实际生成内容的偏离就越严重。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 有证据吗？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 论文按完整模型回答的长短把题目分组。在完整模型要写很长的那些题上，用固定回答训练的方法恢复的准确率很少，也常常写到长度上限。

panels.narration: 论文把这种越写越偏的现象叫“轨迹偏离”。这是第一个难点。
panels.shows: Papi holds one short prepared strip of blank tiles beside a longer loose strip whose later tile sequence differs. Nezu traces only the later differing section with a fingertip, asking for evidence. Keep the strips on a desk with no horizon, calibrated gap, distance ruler or numerical trend; they illustrate different continuations rather than measured divergence.

panels.title: 第二个难点：老师和学生看好的不一样
panels.visual: Papi leans in from the lower-left and gestures toward one half of the blank board; nezu leans in from the lower-right and turns its gaze toward the opposite half with a skeptical raised paw. No judges, placards, ranked props or model avatars.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 这是论文从学生写的回答里取的一个前缀。老师最看好“a”，学生却把它排得很靠后；学生最看好“some”，老师只把它排第三。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 有的给少了，有的给多了，还是同时发生？

panels.narration: 论文比较了学生自己写出的一个前缀。图中能看出：老师和学生对下一步的偏好很不一样。这个前缀的具体原文没有给出。

board.title: 同一个前缀，两边的排序不同（论文图3a）
board.source: 论文图3a（只看排序，不读具体概率值）

panels.title: 低估、高估，和“拿不准”
panels.visual: Papi and kumo examine a small tabletop demonstration with two separate plain vertical sliders, each beside its own fixed reference notch. One movable slider sits below its own reference and the other above its own reference. Papi indicates the two different directions while kumo looks between them. Use unlabeled qualitative positions only, no calibrated heights or numbers; no impossible balance, added student or fog-cloud character.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 论文直接比较了两边的概率，发现同一个前缀里，低估和高估常常同时出现。这叫“分布错位”。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 什么时候最常见？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 在学生拿不准、把概率分散给许多候选的前缀上，这种情况更常见。

panels.narration: 比较同一个候选的概率：老师给得多、学生给得少，叫“低估”；反过来叫“高估”。只是比较两张榜里的名次，还不能判断概率究竟差多少。
panels.shows: Papi and kumo examine a small tabletop demonstration with two separate plain vertical sliders, each beside its own fixed reference notch. One movable slider sits below its own reference and the other above its own reference. Papi indicates the two different directions while kumo looks between them. Use unlabeled qualitative positions only, no calibrated heights or numbers; no impossible balance, added student or fog-cloud character.

panels.title: 重复写个没完：这是观察，不是已证的因果
panels.visual: Papi pins two blank notes apart on a corkboard. Kumo holds a loose cord as if about to connect them, while nezu gently stops that paw before the cord touches either note. The cord remains slack and unattached, showing that a causal link is not established. The notes contain no text, symbols or charts.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 所以学生只要高估了某个词，就会一直重复、停不下来？

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 这话说得太满了。

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 论文观察到两件事：压缩后的模型常把同一句或同一步计算反复地写；学生在两个方向上都有概率错误。可它没有证明“某个词的概率过高就导致循环”这条完整的因果链。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 明白了。反复重复是看到的失败现象，概率错位是另一项观察。

panels.shows: Papi pins two blank notes apart on a corkboard. Kumo holds a loose cord as if about to connect them, while nezu gently stops that paw before the cord touches either note. The cord remains slack and unattached, showing that a causal link is not established. The notes contain no text, symbols or charts.

panels.title: OnQ的路线图
panels.visual: Papi alone stands below the board, leaning forward to introduce the first step with a low sweeping paw gesture that stays outside the blank display. No map, stations, arrows or other characters.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 先讲第一步，后面两步再一步步讲。

panels.narration: 论文的新流程叫OnQ，分别对付前面的两个难点。

board.title: OnQ的三步
steps: 先校准：逐块把学生调得接近老师，作为起点
学生自己写回答，老师在同样的前缀上给出概率
用“动态KL”把学生的概率往老师那边拉
board.note: 第2、3步反复进行。第2步对付前缀对不上，第3步对付两个方向的概率错误。

panels.title: 第一步：逐块校准，给训练一个起点
panels.visual: Two equal-height, already assembled block towers stand side by side. Papi carefully turns a small knob on one existing block of the nearer tower while comparing that level with the corresponding level of the untouched reference tower. Kumo braces the nearer tower so it stays intact. No blocks are added, removed or replaced; no exact match or completed recovery is shown.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 校准时从前往后一块一块调：让学生每一块的输出，尽量接近完整模型里对应那一块的输出。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 校准完就够了吗？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 先恢复一些已经丢掉的能力，再让学生自己生成训练材料。例如1.7B、2位模型在MATH-500上，直接量化得2.40%，校准后得25.60%（表2，均为一组随机设置）。但校准后在长题上仍吃力。

panels.narration: 模型由许多“块”依次叠成，前一块的输出就是后一块的输入。
panels.shows: Two equal-height, already assembled block towers stand side by side. Papi carefully turns a small knob on one existing block of the nearer tower while comparing that level with the corresponding level of the untouched reference tower. Kumo braces the nearer tower so it stays intact. No blocks are added, removed or replaced; no exact match or completed recovery is shown.

panels.title: 第二步：在学生自己写的前缀上请教老师
panels.visual: Only papi appears, crouched below the lower-left board corner and leaning forward with one paw guiding the viewer's attention from the upper part of the board toward the next step lower down. The paw stays outside the display surface. The body makes a clear presenting motion; no kumo-like student, professor, teacher avatar, scroll, probability cards or duplicate workflow.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 这样一来，学生真正会走到的岔路，比如从“Wait”往下的那条，也能得到老师的指导。 论文把这种跟着学生当前输出来学习老师概率的训练，称为on-policy蒸馏。

board.title: 自己写，老师接着指导
steps: 学生自己写出整段回答
把每个位置的前缀交给老师
老师给出下一片段的参考概率
board.note: 更新学生后，再写新的回答，重复训练。

panels.title: 学生的回答不是标准答案
panels.visual: All three gather around one blank draft strip on a desk. Nezu holds its near edge and asks a question; kumo keeps a paw on the same strip. Papi points to that shared strip with one paw while holding a separate small fan of plain cards in the other, visually separating the context being consulted from the guidance supplied. Do not discard or hide the draft; no teacher avatar, answer stamp or guaranteed repair.

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 等一下，学生自己写的回答，被当成标准答案了？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 不是。学生的文字只决定在哪个前缀上提问；下一步该怎么接，看的是老师给出的概率。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 要是前面已经写错了呢？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 老师照样读这段带错的前缀，告诉学生自己会怎么接。这能给学生指导，但不保证一定能把答案救回来。

panels.shows: All three gather around one blank draft strip on a desk. Nezu holds its near edge and asks a question; kumo keeps a paw on the same strip. Papi points to that shared strip with one paw while holding a separate small fan of plain cards in the other, visually separating the context being consulted from the guidance supplied. Do not discard or hide the draft; no teacher avatar, answer stamp or guaranteed repair.

panels.title: 先要一把尺子：KL
panels.visual: Papi sets two unprinted mosaic strips side by side on a desk and inspects their differing patterns with a small magnifier. Kumo brings its face closer to compare the same two strips. No measuring tape, bar chart, geometric distance, scale marks or invented probabilities; the action is comparison, not a literal KL calculator.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 要把学生拉向老师，总得先知道差了多少吧？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 对。常用的尺子叫KL。不过这把尺子有两种量法，量出来的结果不一样。

panels.narration: 要让学生贴近老师，需要衡量两组概率有多不同。KL散度就是一种衡量方式；两组概率完全相同时，它为0。
panels.shows: Papi sets two unprinted mosaic strips side by side on a desk and inspects their differing patterns with a small magnifier. Kumo brings its face closer to compare the same two strips. No measuring tape, bar chart, geometric distance, scale marks or invented probabilities; the action is comparison, not a literal KL calculator.

panels.title: 两种量法的直觉
panels.visual: One papi stands at the end of a table with two different plain mosaic swatches, its body turned toward one while an open paw acknowledges the other. Kumo leans toward the opposite swatch, and nezu raises a cautionary paw between their viewpoints. Keep a single instant and one of each character; no teacher/student figures, duplicate papi, rulers or quantified discrepancy.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 一种量法站在老师那边：老师很看好、学生却给得很少的候选，算作大差距。 另一种站在学生那边：学生押了很多、老师却不看好的候选，算作大差距。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 所以一种更在意“给少了”，另一种更在意“给多了”？

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 是“更在意”，可不是“只管这一种”。

panels.narration: 这是从两种量法的公式得出的直觉。
panels.shows: One papi stands at the end of a table with two different plain mosaic swatches, its body turned toward one while an open paw acknowledges the other. Kumo leans toward the opposite swatch, and nezu raises a cautionary paw between their viewpoints. Keep a single instant and one of each character; no teacher/student figures, duplicate papi, rulers or quantified discrepancy.

panels.title: 两种量法的名字和论文的观察
panels.visual: Kumo at the lower center brings its two open paws together in a combining gesture without touching the board. Papi kneels beside kumo and responds with a measured open-paw gesture. No measuring tools or new compare diagram.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 两边各有长处，那能不能两个一起用？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 这正是动态KL的想法。 旧方法BitDistiller会先根据老师的把握程度设混合比例；OnQ则对每个候选，比较老师和学生的概率来决定比例。

panels.narration: 这些观察来自对学生只做一小步更新的局部检查，并不是说一种量法只会调高、另一种只会调低。

left.label: 前向KL（FKL）：按老师的概率加权
items: 对“老师多、学生少”的候选罚得重
论文观察：更能把严重低估的候选拉向老师

right.label: 反向KL（RKL）：按学生的概率加权
items: 对“学生多、老师少”的候选罚得重
论文观察：更能把严重高估的候选拉向老师

panels.title: 动态KL：每个候选单独定比例
panels.visual: Papi alone at the lower edge alternates its attention between the board's two comparison sides, with its two paws held open toward them at equal neutral height. This is a presentation gesture, not a proportional scale. No mixer, sliders or extra ratio diagram.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 对每个候选，先看老师和学生谁给的概率高。 老师给得高，就多用前向KL；学生给得高，就多用反向KL；两边一样，就各占一半。

panels.narration: 动态KL不是一把全新的尺子，而是对每个候选，把两种量法按比例混在一起。

board.title: 按每个候选的情况混合

left.label: 老师的概率 > 学生（给少了）
items: 前向KL占的比重超过一半

right.label: 学生的概率 > 老师（给多了）
items: 反向KL占的比重超过一半

panels.title: “动态”动在哪里
panels.visual: At a small desk, papi deliberately sets one unlabeled demonstration slider and then holds it in place with a simple clamp. Kumo watches the clamp close, while nezu raises one paw to emphasize pausing at this setting for the current adjustment. No moving-on-its-own controls, student avatar, numerical scale or claim that this position is a measured optimal ratio.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: “动态”是指什么？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 每个前缀、每个候选，都用当下老师和学生的概率重新算一次比例。学生一变，比例也跟着变。 举个假设的比例：如果老师给的概率是学生的2倍，前向KL就占三分之二。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 这只是在决定往哪边多用力。它不会自动判断对错，也不保证每次更新都正确。

panels.narration: 前向KL所占的比例 = 老师的概率 ÷（老师的概率 + 学生的概率），剩下的归反向KL。先按这个比例安排本次调整；下一轮再重新算比例。
panels.shows: At a small desk, papi deliberately sets one unlabeled demonstration slider and then holds it in place with a simple clamp. Kumo watches the clamp close, while nezu raises one paw to emphasize pausing at this setting for the current adjustment. No moving-on-its-own controls, student avatar, numerical scale or claim that this position is a measured optimal ratio.

panels.title: 局部检查支持这个想法
panels.visual: Papi makes one tiny adjustment to a single dial on a small tabletop test fixture. Nezu keeps a larger closed model-shaped box untouched beside it, one paw resting on its lid to emphasize that the whole model is not being retrained in this check. Kumo leans in to inspect the local dial rather than celebrating. No podium, athletes, medals, score displays or success symbols.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 论文只在同一个前缀上，小幅调整这些内部打分，检查严重偏低、偏高的概率是否朝老师靠近。 动态KL纠正低估的表现接近前向KL，纠正高估的表现接近反向KL。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 这个检查没有更新整个模型的权重，不能当作完整训练后的答题效果。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 所以，接下来还得看最终答题成绩。

panels.narration: 模型内部先给候选片段打分，再把分数转成概率。这里的“分数”是内部打分，不是答题成绩。
panels.shows: Papi makes one tiny adjustment to a single dial on a small tabletop test fixture. Nezu keeps a larger closed model-shaped box untouched beside it, one paw resting on its lid to emphasize that the whole model is not being retrained in this check. Kumo leans in to inspect the local dial rather than celebrating. No podium, athletes, medals, score displays or success symbols.

panels.title: 拿什么模型来试
panels.visual: On a table are three plain open trays, each containing two identical-size unmarked sample chips. Papi moves the third tray into line; kumo checks that each tray has a pair, and nezu points toward the nearest pair with empty hands. This is only a count of three model choices times two precision settings, not a scale drawing of parameter counts or memory savings. No robots or labeled clipboard.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 机制讲完了，该看结果了。

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 每个模型都压成3位和2位两种，一共六种设置。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 在这篇论文比较的2位、3位设置中，2位的刻度更少：每个权重只能选4个刻度。

panels.narration: 实验用的是Qwen3系列的三个模型：1.7B、4B、8B。B是billion（十亿），指参数（权重）的个数，1.7B大约是17亿个。 这里的2位、3位只指权重；计算过程中传递的数值仍用16位。
panels.shows: On a table are three plain open trays, each containing two identical-size unmarked sample chips. Papi moves the third tray into line; kumo checks that each tray has a pair, and nezu points toward the nearest pair with empty hands. This is only a count of three model choices times two precision settings, not a scale drawing of parameter counts or memory savings. No robots or labeled clipboard.

panels.title: 九项测试
panels.visual: Papi stands low at one side of the board introducing its categories. Kumo leans forward from the lower edge with an interested raised paw; nezu sits on the opposite side and carefully raises a qualifying paw about the evaluation setup. No corridor, exam rooms, category symbols or additional students.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 测试覆盖数学、代码、知识和按指令办事四类。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: AIME和LiveCodeBench的回答特别长，正好考长推理。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 大部分分数是三组随机设置的平均；AutoRound只测了一组。

panels.narration: 测试使用推理模式。代码分数看一次回答通过测试的比例，其他项目看答对或符合要求的比例。分数越高越好。

board.title: 九项测试（平均分是九项的简单平均）

panels.title: 拿来对比的现有方法
panels.visual: Nezu crouches at the lower-right board corner with a scrutinizing expression and a paw extended toward the comparison. Papi sits lower-left, responding with an open, explanatory paw. No runners, starting line, referee costume or method mascots.

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 跟谁比，很重要。

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 右边三种都用同一批写好的问答对来训练。其中EfficientQAT和ReasoningQAT还和OnQ从同一个校准起点出发。

left.label: 训练后量化（PTQ）
items: 把已有模型量化；不做后续的QAT训练

right.label: 用固定回答做量化感知训练（QAT）

panels.title: 8B、2位：领先了，也还有差距
panels.visual: Kumo at the lower-left is caught midway through a small excited hop, while nezu at the lower-right calmly holds one paw up to temper the celebration and directs its gaze back to the board. Do not draw score marks, extra bars, medals or victory banners.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 比最强的对比方法高了10.26个百分点！

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 可离完整模型还差11.14个百分点，压缩的代价还在。

board.title: 8B、2位：九项平均分
board.subtitle: Qwen3-8B；比较量化方法，同时保留完整模型作参照

panels.title: 六种设置都看一遍
panels.visual: Papi kneels below one corner of the board and sweeps a paw along its outside edge as if reviewing rows. Nezu crouches at the other corner, follows the same direction with focused eyes and raises one paw to qualify the conclusion. No kumo, ledger, extra table or writing.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 这六种设置里，OnQ的九项平均分在所比较的量化方法中都是最高的。 2位时更进一步：每个规模、每项测试，它都高于论文比较的其他量化方法。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 3位时领先少得多，也不是每项测试都第一。

panels.narration: 在本文测试范围内，压到2位时，OnQ相对其他量化方法的优势更大。

board.title: 九项平均分（%）：OnQ与最强量化对比方法

panels.title: 长推理题上领先最多
panels.visual: Papi at lower-left gestures toward the results with a restrained explanatory posture. Nezu at lower-right leans back, looks toward the board's comparison area and extends a paw to emphasize the remaining gap. No mountain, summit, climbers, teacher figure or finish flag.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 六种设置里有五种，OnQ领先最多的测试是AIME或LiveCodeBench，两项都要写很长。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 可在这项上它离完整模型也最远，还差27.78个百分点。

panels.narration: AIME是竞赛数学题，回答通常很长。

board.title: 8B、2位：AIME 24–26得分
board.subtitle: 回答很长的竞赛数学；越高越好

panels.title: 写不完的情况少了
panels.visual: Below the board, kumo begins a small relieved celebratory gesture. Papi crouches beside kumo and directs one open paw toward the result area without covering it. Nezu stands at the other lower corner with a measured palm-out gesture, reminding them to keep the evaluation scope in view. No scroll shelves, finished-versus-cut samples, scissors, added counts or speed symbols.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 写不完的情况少多了。

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 在六种设置里，OnQ的平均截断率都是QAT方法中最低的。

panels.narration: 这组比较把回答长度上限设为32768个文字片段。到了上限仍未写完，就被切断，记为“截断”。

board.title: 8B、2位：被长度上限截断的回答比例
board.subtitle: 九项测试的平均；越低越好

panels.title: 平均回答也更短，但范围要讲清
panels.visual: Papi and nezu sit across the corner of a small empty table. Papi leans forward with one paw making a modest open explanatory gesture, while nezu leans in and gently raises one palm to qualify the conclusion. Their gaze meets over the empty table, making the evidence-and-limits exchange visible. Do not draw answer samples, length comparisons, probability diagrams, scoreboards, timers or speed symbols.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 2位时，在MATH-500、AIME、LiveCodeBench上，九种情况里有八种，它的平均回答比最准的对比方法更短。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 这些都是在论文的评测里测到的，换了别的任务还得重新测。

panels.title: 反复照抄的错误少了
panels.visual: Nezu leans in from the lower-right with a magnifier held near its eye, inspecting the display without touching it. Papi at lower-left holds an open paw toward nezu as if explaining how the cases were reviewed. No answer-sheet pile, scribbles, classification badges or invented sample counts.

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 重复错误是怎么判定的？

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 让一个AI模型在不知道是哪种方法的情况下判两遍；有分歧或拿不准的，由作者通读后定。 把答案分类后，论文发现：OnQ相对ReasoningQAT增加的答对比例，大部分与重复错误比例的下降相对应。

panels.narration: “重复错误”指一句话、一段内容或一步计算被一遍又一遍地照抄。这里统计同一组随机设置（种子42）的输出。

board.title: 1.7B、2位：MATH-500上出现重复错误的题目比例
board.subtitle: 越低越好；后两根给出三种固定回答训练方法的范围

panels.title: 固定回答对比自己写：一组对照
panels.visual: Kumo leans forward at the lower center in an excited noticing pose. Nezu gently raises a cautionary paw beside kumo; papi on the other side responds with a careful clarifying gesture. All three orient toward the same code result area. No training tracks, question boxes, extra scoresheets or causal arrows.

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 同样用动态KL，换成在自己写的前缀上训练，高了8.40个百分点。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 但两组的题目来源不同：固定回答组用的是对比方法那批问答对，自己写组用的是论文自己的题库。所以这不是只改了一个变量的实验。

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 还有，69.40是这组对照实验的数，和主表里同为1.7B、2位的69.33不是同一次测量。

board.title: 1.7B、2位：MATH-500得分
board.subtitle: 三组从同一个校准起点出发，训练用的回答片段总数相同；越高越好

panels.title: 都让学生自己写，再比较量法
panels.visual: Papi stands low beside the board, presenting the comparison with one open paw. Nezu leans closer and raises a second paw in a questioning gesture rather than applauding. No extra candidate cards, measurement props or significance symbols.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 这组结果里，动态KL的MATH-500分数，比单用前向KL高1.0个百分点，比单用反向KL高4.2个百分点。

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 表中没有给出波动范围，不能据这一次的差距断言它总会胜出。 这组对照支持该设计在这里有帮助，但还不能解释每一个概率偏差怎样造成了具体的推理错误。

panels.narration: 另一组实验都让学生自己写，使用相同起点、训练题目和400步预算。它只用数学题训练，与上一格不是同一组实验。

board.title: 都自己写：MATH-500得分（%）
board.subtitle: Qwen3-1.7B，权重2位；另一组独立对照

panels.title: 要记住的限制
panels.visual: Nezu sits at the lower-right with one paw held gently upright in a cautioning gesture. Kumo at the lower-left lowers its previously enthusiastic paws and listens thoughtfully. No papi, warning sign, caution icon or separate list.

dialogue.speaker: nezu
dialogue.text: 结果好，这些限制也得写清楚。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 特别是第二条：变好了，但还没追上完整模型。

board.title: 限制
items: 只测了Qwen3这一个系列的三个规模，别的模型家族没有测
2位仍明显不如完整模型：8B的九项平均是70.68对81.82
都是整体统计：截断和重复变少了，但不保证每道题都能写完、写对
论文没有报告OnQ与对比方法在训练花费上的比较

panels.title: 回到开头的三个问题
panels.visual: Kumo at the lower center turns slightly toward papi and counts through the recap with its small paws held near its chest, without marking the board. Papi seated beside kumo listens with a warm nod. No nezu, handwritten checkmarks, additional list or all-clear stamp.

dialogue.speaker: papi
dialogue.text: 回到开头的三个问题。

dialogue.speaker: kumo
dialogue.text: 现在我说得清了：在哪里练，跟谁学，怎么拉，效果到哪一步。

board.title: 我们的问题，按顺序回答
items: 固定回答未必覆盖学生实际写出的内容；同一前缀上，它还可能同时高估、低估不同候选。
先校准，再让学生自己写。原始完整模型给出下一步的参考概率；动态KL根据每个候选给多了还是给少了，混合两种训练方向。
在论文测过的六种设置里，OnQ的平均分领先其他量化方法，但仍落后于完整模型。回答更短、截断和重复更少，也不代表每道题都会答对。

abstract_claims.text: Quantization-aware training (QAT) exists to recover reasoning ability in low-bit large language models
abstract_claims.quote: Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in lowbit large language models (LLMs).

abstract_claims.text: Existing QAT recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the full-precision teacher on fixed response sequences.
abstract_claims.quote: Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences.

abstract_claims.text: Even after standard QAT, low-bit models still fail at long reasoning tasks and often run out of token space even when the full model fits its answer fine
abstract_claims.quote: However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model.

abstract_claims.text: There are two core challenges preventing fixing this gap
abstract_claims.quote: We identify two challenges in closing this gap.

abstract_claims.text: First: fixed-response training creates a mismatch between training prefixes and the prefixes the student actually generates, and this gap grows as responses get longer
abstract_claims.quote: First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen.

abstract_claims.text: Second: on its own generated prefixes, the student underpredicts some next tokens and overpredicts others, and this happens most often at high-uncertainty positions
abstract_claims.quote: Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes.

abstract_claims.text: The authors present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline combining on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL
abstract_claims.quote: We present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline that combines on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL.

abstract_claims.text: OnQ starts with block-wise calibration, then has the student generate responses and receives teacher supervision on exactly those student-generated prefixes
abstract_claims.quote: Starting from block-wise calibration, the quantized student generates responses and receives full-precision teacher supervision on its own prefixes.

abstract_claims.text: Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate's teacher-student probability ratio to balance fixing under and over prediction
abstract_claims.quote: Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate’s teacher–student probability ratio to balance correction of under- and overprediction.

abstract_claims.text: Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B at 2 and 3 bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest average score across 9 benchmarks, with largest gains on long reasoning tasks
abstract_claims.quote: Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B at 2- and 3-bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest nine-benchmark average, with the largest gains on long-horizon reasoning benchmarks.

abstract_claims.text: At 2 bits, OnQ outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, and improves Qwen3-8B average score by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline
abstract_claims.quote: At 2 bits, it outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, improving the Qwen3-8B average by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline.

abstract_claims.text: OnQ also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and fewer repetitive errors
abstract_claims.quote: It also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and repetitive errors.
